 Arkade Developers Limited 
Q2 FY 2027 Earnings Conference Call  
October 29, 2026 
 
 
Moderator: 
Ladies and gentlemen, good day and welcome to the Arkade Developers Limited Q2-H1-FY27 
earnings call, hosted by Valorem Advisors. 
As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode and there will be an 
opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need 
assistance during this conference call, please signal an operator by pressing “*”, then “0” on 
your touchtone phone. 
I now hand the conference over to Ms. Purvangi Jain from Valorem Advisors. Thank you and 
over to you. 
Purvangi Jain: 
Thank you. Good evening, everyone and a very warm welcome to you all. My name is Purvangi 
Jain from Valorem Advisors. We represent the investor relations of Arkade Developers Limited. 
On behalf of the company, I would like to thank you all for participating in the company's 
earnings call for the 2nd Quarter and first half of the financial year 2027. Before we begin, a 
quick cautionary statement. 
Some of the statements made in today's earnings conference call may be forward-looking in 
nature. Such forward-looking statements are subject to risk and uncertainties, which could 
cause actual results to differ from those anticipated. Such statements are based on 
management's belief as well as assumptions made by and information currently available to 
the management. Audiences are cautioned not to place any undue reliance on these forward-
looking statements in making any investment decision. The purpose of today's conference call 
is purely to educate and bring awareness about the company's fundamental business and 
financial performance for the period under review. 
Now, I would like to introduce you to the management participating with us in today's earnings 
call and hand it over to them for their opening remarks. 
We have with us Mr. Arpit Jain – Whole Time Director, Mr. Samshet Shetye – Chief Financial 
Officer and Ms. Deepti Nair, Head of Marketing. 
Without any further delay, I request Mr. Arpit Jain to give his opening remarks. Thank you and 
over to you, sir. 

 
Page 2 of 13 
Arpit Jain: 
Good evening, everyone and thank you for joining us for Arkade Developers Q2 Financial Year 
2027 Earnings Conference Call. 
Mumbai's residential real estate market continues to offer meaningful long-term growth 
opportunities and at Arkade, our focus remains on building a scalable business backed by 
quality development, disciplined capital allocation and consistent execution. During the 
quarter, we maintained our operational momentum with collections registering healthy 
growth while continuing to strengthen our development pipeline and prepare for the next 
phase of expansion. 
In terms of numbers, our collections grew by 22% year-on-year to Rs. 183 crore in Q2 Financial 
Year 2027, taking first-half collections to Rs. 347 crore, an 8% increase over the corresponding 
period last year. 
Pre-sales for the quarter stood at Rs. 151 crore, with first-half pre-sales at Rs. 306 crore. 
While pre-sales remained moderate amid evolving market dynamics, we continue to prioritize 
timely project delivery, customer confidence and operational efficiency as key drivers of 
sustainable business growth. On the business development front, we further strengthened our 
presence across western Mumbai with the addition of four redevelopment projects across 
Malad, Kandivali and Borivali. These projects collectively span approximately 11 acres, with an 
estimated saleable carpet area of 15 lakh square feet and a combined GDV potential of 
approximately Rs. 5000 crore. These additions reinforce our redevelopment-led growth story 
and expand our presence across established residential micro-markets. 
Execution continues to remain one of our core strengths. During the phase, we achieved an 
important milestone at Arkade Eden in Malad West, where we handed over our flats to our 
buyers, and Arkade Pearl Phase 1, where we received the occupation certificate ahead of the 
committed RERA timeline. This reflects our emphasis on construction efficiency, quality 
development and timely delivery, which remains central to building long-term customer trust. 
Looking ahead, our development portfolio provides strong visibility for the coming years. We 
have a robust pipeline with an estimated GDV of approximately Rs. 19,000 crore, across 5.7 
million square feet of saleable carpet area. We are targeting the launch of two projects with a 
combined GDV of approximately Rs. 2,850 crore in Q3 FY27. These launches, alongside our 
continued focus on strategic land acquisitions across key micro-markets in the MMR, will 
strengthen our portfolio and support our long-term growth ambitions. 
As we move into the second half of FY27, we remain focused on converting our development 
pipeline into execution-led growth, expanding our presence in attractive micro-markets and 
delivering lasting value to our customers and shareholders. We believe that a combination of 
a strong project pipeline, financial discipline and a continued commitment to quality will 

 
Page 3 of 13 
position Arkade well for its next phase of growth. With that, I would now like to invite Ms. 
Deepti Nair to share her perspective on the marketing initiatives and strategy at Arkade. 
Deepti Nair: 
Thank you, Mr. Jain. At Arkade, our marketing approach is centered on building a strong and 
recognizable brand, understanding buyer preferences, creating meaningful engagement with 
prospective customers. Our positioning is built around premium residential development, 
quality construction and design excellence and our track record of timely product delivery. 
We aim to further strengthen our brand presence across Mumbai through consistent brand 
communication, targeted marketing initiatives and increase visibility across relevant customer 
touchpoints with the objective of enhancing the brand's recall. Looking ahead with two project 
launches targeted in Q3 of FY27, having a combined GDV of Rs. 2,850 crore, our focus will be 
on aligning marketing and customer outreach with the upcoming launch plan. 
We aim to communicate the value proposition of each of the product's effectiveness based on 
its location, product offering and target customer segment, while supporting customer 
inquiries and sales conversion through consistent and personalized engagement. In parallel, 
we intend to strengthen customer loyalty by nurturing long-term relationships with existing 
customers, enhancing personal engagement and creating positive customer experiences that 
encourage repeat purchases and referrals. We believe that stratified customers and word-of-
mouth recommendations can play an important role in expanding our customer base, 
generating quality lead sales and strengthening brand credibility. 
By combining targeted marketing, enhancing brand visibility, customer centric engagement 
and continued commitment to quality and timely delivery, we will aim to improve the top-of-
the-mind brand recall via customer loyalty and referral-led sales, and support our case's long-
term growth. 
With that, I would now like to hand over the call to our Chief Financial Officer, Mr. Samshet 
Shetye, who will take you through the company's financial performance. 
Samshet Shetye: 
Thank you Deepti, Good Evening everyone. Let me take you through our financial 
performance for the 2nd Quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. 
Coming to our financial performance for the quarter: 
Revenues from operations stood at Rs. 145 crores, operating EBITDA was Rs. 35 crores, 
translating into EBITDA margin of 24%. Gross margin improved to 35% during the quarter 
compared to the previous quarter, reflecting the strength of our project economics and our 
continued focus on maintaining healthy project-level profitability. 
Profit after tax stood at Rs. 25 crores, with a PAT margin of 17.14%. The year-on-year decline 
in revenue was partially attributed to a higher base in the corresponding quarter last year, 
when four projects commenced revenue recognition after crossing the 25% construction 

 
Page 4 of 13 
threshold. During the current quarter, we did not have a similar contribution from crossing this 
milestone. As a result, revenue recognition was relatively lower. 
However, our strong development pipeline and ongoing project execution provide visibility for 
revenue recognition in the coming period. For the first half of FY27, revenues from operations 
stood at Rs. 292 crores, operating EBITDA was Rs. 62 crores, with EBITDA margin of 21.4%. 
Gross margin stood at 32%, while profit after tax was Rs. 44 crores, translating into PAT margin 
of 15.1%. From a business perspective, collections grew by 22% year-on-year to Rs. 183 crores 
during the quarter, taking H1 FY27 collections to Rs. 347 crores, up 8%. Pre-sales stood at Rs. 
151 crores from the quarter and Rs. 306 crores for the first half. While pre-sales remained 
moderate amid evolving market dynamics, we continued to focus on customer engagement, 
execution and strengthening our sales momentum. Our balance sheet remains robust. 
As of September 30, 2026, we had a liquid cash balance of Rs. 119 crores against gross debt of 
Rs. 56 crores, resulting in a net liquid cash position of Rs. 63 crores. This provides us with the 
financial flexibility to pursue attractive growth opportunities while maintaining prudent capital 
allocation. Looking ahead, we remain confident in our long-term growth process, supported by 
our strong project pipeline, planned launches, healthy collections and disciplined financial 
management. 
We will continue to focus on timely project execution, operational efficiency and sustainable 
growth to create long-term value for all stakeholders. 
With that, we conclude our opening remarks and will now be happy to take your questions. 
Thank you.

recognition bracket over the next Q4 or the Q1 of the next financial year. So, this should help

Arpit Jain: 
So, overall, our realization has been better on the higher side on the existing projects and that 
has driven the EBITDA margin on the higher side or gross profit margin on the higher side. We 
have completed two developments as well in Malad, Arkade Eden and in Vile Parle, Arkade 
Pearl where we have received OC. So, once you received OC, there is certain natural 
appreciation as well in the product. And apart from that also, our realization in other ongoing 
projects has improved a bit and that is the reason the margins are a bit higher. 
Trishla:

Arpit Jain:

years, we have done around 15 redevelopment projects completed and handed over. So, 
around 5-6 redevelopment projects are already ongoing right now. And we have obviously, you 
can see the portfolio as well, we have good amount of redevelopment in the pipeline as well. 
So, in terms of our bidding, we have been very selective in choosing the projects in which we 
have to bid. And we have a lot of criteria in terms of location size, in terms of development 
potential, in terms of revenue of the project, GDV. And once we choose a project, we try to go 
all out in the tendering process and in the bidding process to get the project in our city.

months.
